div.div:
How to read it
1 Anonymous MCP call from the Session 1 page. CORS allows the GitHub Pages origin only.
2 Pattern B: each tool maps to one REST operation; the gateway answers from synthetic tickets.
3 Pattern A: forwarded as is; the protected server checks the same token again.
4 A 401 names this metadata: where to sign in, which scope.
5 Delegated token for this API only: scope Mcp.Read (az account get-access-token).
6 The gateway checks signature, issuer, audience and Mcp.Read; 30 calls per minute per caller.
7 Each MCP app gets its own token (managed identity) for the ticket API. The caller token is never forwarded.
8 Images are pulled with AcrPull, no registry password.
Lines: solid = request · dashed purple = token · dotted blue = metadata lookup
Known gap: a direct call to ca-mcp-auth with a valid token still works (not restricted to the gateway yet).
